ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.

18. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.

20. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

21. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

22. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly
